set.body:
Requester: ScalaFIM bd-01M3WCQD1MFW1WRTJP6C6A2ZFS (foreign store; not a blocking edge). The decision recorded 2026-10-01: ScalaFIM keeps its real MNI152NLin2009cAsym -> fsLR32k route unavailable until a pointwise inverse qualifies. Its frozen budgets are unchanged.

Why. ScalaFIM's lattice candidate (branch work/fslr-lattice-inverse-20261001, commit acb675ac) inverts the TemplateFlow 2009c<-6Asym composite through NumericalInversion on the full 182x218x182 6Asym lattice. That passes the provider gates (coverage 1.0, reverse residual max 0.139 mm). It fails ScalaFIM's frozen all-vertex budget (round trip through the exact map <= 0.05 mm): measured max 0.081 / 0.059 mm. The cause is trilinear interpolation of the 1 mm inverse lattice. It also costs 135-224 s and about 2.3 GB to estimate 7.2M inverse samples for roughly 65k requested points. Note: ScalaFIM pins reframe4s 9a4508351d74567147b8ea3221d82db89e5892b0; the local main checkout (fa015c3) does not contain it, and main has another actor's uncommitted changes. Use an isolated worktree from the correct base.

Bounded scope (from the maintainer-adopted review):
1. Pointwise inversion of a declared map, reusing the existing NumericalInversion machinery where practical (fixed-point iteration, settings, divergence handling). Return a per-query result with residual |pull(x) - y|, iteration count, and an explicit status: converged / max-iterations / diverged / left support / failure. It never silently falls back.
2. For displacement-then-affine chains, undo the affine analytically and solve only the displacement component. Qualify an initialization that needs no inverse lattice (e.g. identity, or identity minus the displacement sampled at the query). Lattice warm starts may exist, but the qualification must pass without one.
3. The result remains a numerical estimate with evidence. It is not an exact inverse and not a SmoothIso contract; convergence depends on the map and the initialization (cf. ITK InvertDisplacementFieldImageFilter limitations).
4. Tests: analytic inverses (constant and affine-composed fields), smooth contractive fields against an independent solve, non-contractive and divergent cases returning typed statuses, support edges, plus JVM and Scala.js.
Consumer qualification (ScalaFIM-owned, not this ticket): all-vertex independent oracle, voxel/value/support disagreements on the intended consumer fixtures, real JVM and Scala.js cost. ScalaFIM will generalize BridgeExactness.Approximate evidence beyond LatticeInverseEvidence for the swap.
set.title: Pointwise inverse of declared displacement-then-affine maps with per-query evidence
